title: A Job Application Email
text:
Dear Mr Smith, I am writing about the job advertisement on your website. I would like to apply for the position of office assistant. I have two years of experience in an office. I also speak English and German well.

Please find my CV attached to this email. I am available for an interview on any day next week. Thank you for your time. I look forward to hearing from you.

Yours sincerely, Anna Nowak

questions.text: What position does the writer want to apply for?
What is attached to the email?
Why does the writer begin with 'Dear Mr Smith' and end with 'Yours sincerely'?
options: The email is formal and polite
The writer is a close friend of Mr Smith
The email is meant as a joke
The writer is angry with Mr Smith

questions.text: What can we infer about the writer?
options: She is interested in the job and wants to meet the employer
She is not interested in the job
She wants to sell the company
She has never used a computer

vocabulary.definition: a job or role in an organization
to ask formally for a job
free and able to do something at a certain time
sent together with an email or letter

paragraph_translations: Szanowny Panie Smith, piszę w sprawie ogłoszenia o pracy na Pana stronie internetowej. Chciałabym ubiegać się o stanowisko asystentki biurowej. Mam dwuletnie doświadczenie pracy w biurze. Dobrze mówię też po angielsku i po niemiecku.

Proszę o przyjęcie mojego CV załączonego do tej wiadomości. Jestem dostępna na rozmowę kwalifikacyjną w dowolny dzień w przyszłym tygodniu. Dziękuję za poświęcony czas. Z niecierpliwością czekam na odpowiedź. Z poważaniem, Anna Nowak
